mapper.sql: p.party_id AS partyId,f.profile_id AS profileId,f.draft_application_id AS draftApplicationId,f.approved_time AS approvedTime, (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_party_relation shared WHERE shared.related_party_id=p.party_id AND (shared.client_application_id IS NULL OR shared.client_application_id != #{application.applicationId} OR shared.status != 'DRAFT')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_client c JOIN t_client_application a ON a.client_id=c.client_id WHERE c.party_id=p.party_id AND a.status='APPROVED') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_partner_application pa WHERE pa.target_party_profile_id=f.profile_id AND pa.status='APPROVED') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_operating_entity_application oa WHERE oa.party_profile_id=f.profile_id AND oa.status='APPROVED')) AS shared

relation_id AS relationId,related_party_id AS relatedPartyId,relation_type AS relationType, ownership_percentage AS ownershipPercentage,effective_from AS effectiveFrom,effective_to AS effectiveTo,status, ubo_basis AS uboBasis,job_title AS jobTitle,nominee_flag AS nomineeFlag,control_nature AS controlNature
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_party_relation WHERE organization_party_id=#{organizationId} AND related_party_id=#{partyId} AND relation_type=#{type} AND relation_id != #{excludeId})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_party_relation SET relation_type=#{values.relationType},ownership_percentage=#{values.ownershipPercentage}, effective_from=#{values.effectiveFrom},effective_to=#{values.effectiveTo},ubo_basis=#{values.uboBasis}, job_title=#{values.jobTitle},nominee_flag=#{values.nomineeFlag},control_nature=#{values.controlNature},update_time=#{now} WHERE relation_id=#{id} AND client_application_id=#{application.applicationId} AND organization_party_id=#{application.partyId} AND status='DRAFT'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_party_relation WHERE relation_id=#{id} AND client_application_id=#{application.applicationId} AND organization_party_id=#{application.partyId} AND status='DRAFT'
